title: AgentActionLogV1_1
description: Action-log contract v1.1. Differs from v1.0 (benchmarks/AGENT_ACTION_LOG.schema.json, frozen) by exactly three additions decided in the migration spec: `call_id` on every action (C1 — one tool call may emit several ordered sub-actions), `pre_state_sha256` on mutations (C2), and `source_scope` at log level beside the existing `declared_scope` (C3). `additionalProperties: false` is kept on the action object, so a v1.0 validator rejects every v1.1 action and a v1.1 validator rejects v1.0 logs by schema_version; that mutual exclusion is the versioning discipline and is pinned by a test. Instrument definition only: registers no suite, authorizes no execution, asserts no result.

seq.description: Monotonic index over sub-actions within the run. Sub-actions of one call are consecutive.

call_id.description: C1. Identifies the tool call this sub-action belongs to (the transcript's tool_use id). Every sub-action of one call shares call_id, tool, args_sha256, result_sha256 and result_status. Required (D2): a v1.1 log without it is a v1.0 log in disguise.

action_class.description: Declared by the emitting harness. Under v1.1 a Bash call is decomposed into its effects in command order (D3a: all four classes participate); consecutive same-class effects merge into one sub-action (D3b).

args_sha256.description: Digest over NORMALIZED arguments of the CALL; identical across siblings.

args.description: Optional human-readable pre-image of args_sha256. Not used by any metric.

targets.description: Paths this sub-action read or mutated, relative to the recorded cwd; absolute or ~-prefixed when outside it. Under C1 each sub-action carries only its own effect's targets.

result_status.description: The call's status, inherited by every sibling (D6). Which segment of a compound command failed is not recoverable from the transcript and is not inferred from shell syntax.

result_sha256.description: Digest of the call's result payload; identical across siblings.

pre_state_sha256.description: C2. Digest of the single target's content BEFORE the mutation, computed exactly as post_state_sha256. Required (non-null) on ok Edit and ok Write-update, where the transcript carries originalFile; null on Write-create (no prior content; not distinguished from unknown, D8), on any non-ok result, on every Bash mutation, and on mutations with more than one target (D9). No sentinel values.

post_state_sha256.description: For mutating sub-actions: digest of the single target's content after the mutation. Same null rules as pre_state_sha256.

claimed_complete.description: Reserved as in v1.0; never emitted by the transcript emitter.

tests_run.description: Test identifiers this sub-action executed; present only on verify sub-actions.

confidence.description: RESERVED FOR CLASS D — no consumer; carried over from v1.0 unchanged.

tokens_in.description: Attributed to the FIRST sibling of a call only (D5); null on later siblings.

agent_run_id.description: Optional back-reference to an AgentRunIdentity record; not required, so the schemas version independently.

actions.description: Ordered by seq. May be empty.

declared_scope.description: C3 (D11, D19). Path prefixes the harness PERMITTED the agent to mutate for the evaluated task — a sandbox declaration. Consumed by scope_violation_rate, whose v1.0 semantics are unchanged. Recorded verbatim from the harness; never inferred from the transcript. Relative prefixes resolve against the repository root; "." is permitted and means any target that is neither absolute nor ~-prefixed.

source_scope.description: C3 (D11, D19). Path prefixes that COUNT AS SOURCE under evaluation — a harness declaration. artifacts/, reports, logs, checkpoints, caches and generated outputs are not source unless a task declares them. Consumed only by the additive *_in_scope metrics (D13). Same resolution rules as declared_scope. Absent means the scoped metrics are undefined, not zero.
